text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Daring Heart! She's done it, Daring 
Heart! —She has achieved a tremendous 
feat...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having conquered the Oka Sho, Daring 
Heart followed Rhein Kraft to take on the 
NHK Mile Cup—"
choice_data_list_en: (Heart, that's incredible...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And winning the Shuka Sho as well... she 
conquered all of these races, becoming the 
first-ever— irregular Triple Tiara 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She went on to conquer the Oaks and the 
Shuka Sho as well... becoming the 
first-ever "Irregular Quadruple Crown" 
Umamusume to claim victory across all of 
these races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for Daring Heart, who carved open new 
possibilities for Tiara Umamusume and 
etched her name into history...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume DJ
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~~~~!! The moment you've all been 
waiting for! Our Queen, Daring Heart! Show 
'em what you've gooot~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, is that DJ the one with over a 
million Umastagram followers?!" "The 
coffee truck is here~!" "There'll be 
fireworks tonight♡" "Total festival 
vibes~"
choice_data_list:
(As far as the eye can see, it's 
Umamusume, Umamusume, Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's friends are throwing a 
party to celebrate her great achievement, 
and I was invited as well, but...
choice_data_list: （見渡す限りウマ娘、ウマ娘、ウマ娘……）
choice_data_list_en: (As far as the eye can see, it's Umamusume, Umamusume, Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Are you having fun?
choice_data_list: （まさかこんなに大規模だとは……！）
choice_data_list_en: (I had no idea it was on such a massive scale...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, I want to dance with 
you! I'll lead the way♪"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Heart~~~! Congrats~~! This is from us! To 
our special queen♡"
choice_data_list_en: W-Well... that's—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! You all prepared this for me? It's 
so colorful...! So cute! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-chan, that was way too amazing...! 
Though... at first, you were only aiming 
for the Triple Tiara, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's true. It's a bit different from the 
image of a Queen I envisioned back then, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A crown that no one has ever worn before? 
Honestly, wouldn't that suit me 
perfectly?"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Heart~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People gathered endlessly around Daring 
Heart. It was a familiar sight, but... 
today, it felt extraordinarily dazzling.
choice_data_list_en: (Such incredible popularity...!)
(Incredible popularity...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list_en: (...Guess I'll go take a short break.)
(...I think I'll go take a short break.)

text_block_list.text: —Hey, you! This area is off-limits!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Juuust kidding! ♡
choice_data_list_en: Wait! I-I'm so sor—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just lowered my voice a little, 
you know? I thought you of all people 
would notice.
choice_data_list_en: Heart...! You startled me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Were you spacing out so much you didn't 
notice? ...You're not really used to 
lively places like this, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I knew that, but... I wanted you to come 
too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because—you were the one who gave me 
wings... to forge new possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case... you should be celebrated 
too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume DJ
text_block_list.text: —Everyone! DAAAANCE~~~!!
choice_data_list_en: Heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Dance time begins. If you want to slip 
away, do it now before anyone notices.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna go dance too! Well, see you at 
training!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart walks away. ...She's always 
the one leading me out into dazzling 
places. And yet...
choice_data_list_en: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she wishes to be together right now... 
then—
choice_data_list_en: (...Are you sure you don't need to answer?)
(...You sure you don't need to answer?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...What is it? I'll show up to training 
properly, so—
choice_data_list_en: Heart...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh...—
choice_data_list_en: W-W-Won't you dance with me... here...!?
W-W-Won't you dance with me... here...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being in the spotlight where she always 
is... intimidates me. But here on the 
sidelines... right now, when it's just 
her—
choice_data_list: ...I want to... dance with you too.
...I want to... dance with you too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list_en: ...I want to... dance with you too.
...I want to dance with you... too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, that thing you do... is it all 
part of a plan?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez... My heart won't be able to take 
it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...The answer is of course, I'd love to! 
—Let us dance!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh~? Not here either... Where could 
Heart-san have gone?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm still frustrated, but... I have to 
properly congratulate them!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... for showing me a new path to 
the Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Truly... a brave person. I must be 
sure to offer my proper congratulations—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...You two, how about we save the chat for 
later?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: For now—let's not disturb them.
